notes.title: First update after launch
notes.content:
The first week after SANYA's release has passed! Thanks to everyone who played, and gave feedback. Your kind words tell us that the 4 years spent developing the game were worth it.

Today we're sharing our first update! Here's what's new:

[olist]
[*] SANYA is now available on MacOS!
[*] Fixed a bug that made it hard to dial numbers on the phone.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mini-game with the phone would freeze after the first phrase and not allow further progress.
[*] Saves are now showing correctly.
[/olist]

We're still working on a bug where sometimes [spoiler] you can't pull the Punpkin out of the tree roots [/spoiler]. If you come across this issue, please email us at helpnodegames@gmail.com.

If you find any other bugs, please let us know wherever you can: here in the comments, game discussions, on Twitter, or via email.

Sending everyone hugs, wishing you a fantastic week, and may Pumpkin always be by your side!

notes.title: Marry Christmas!
notes.content:
Marry Christmas, folks!

We've prepared a small update so you can enjoy some time with SANYA :)

[h2]Firstly, we've made a new trailer![/h2]
It includes several new shots, especially from the mini-games awaiting you in the game. Watch, like, comment!
[previewyoutube=xeibLfmWw9U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Secondly, we've updated the free demo version![/h2]
What's new:
[list]
[*] Updated the ending and interaction mechanics with the doggie;
[*] Optimized the game and added the ability to lower graphics quality and enhance performance;
[*] Improved sound design;
[*] Improved the UI, particularly in the settings menu;
[*] Fixed bugs that you reported.
[/list]

[h2]Here are answers to some questions you might have[/h2]
[h3]Should I play the demo if I've already completed it entirely?[/h3]
Most likely, no. The main story and gameplay remain the same — we focused more on polishing. The only new feature that might interest you is the new mechanic with the doggie. A small teaser appears at the very end of the demo, and if that already sounds intriguing, we won't stop you. You can always enjoy SANYA for a second time!

If you haven't played the demo at all, then the answer is definitely yes! If you tried but your PC couldn't handle it — also yes, it should work well even on weaker machines now.

[h3]How long does it take to complete the demo?[/h3]
Anywhere from 20 to 40 minutes, depending on how much attention you pay to details and if you enjoy deviating from the main storyline.

[h3]When will SANYA be released?[/h3]
Right now, we're at a stage where the entire game is complete but still needs some fine-tuning. The last thing we'd want is to release a "raw" game where something doesn't work. So, we're working on polishing and improving everything that's already there. Thanks for your patience!

Have a great weekend and a fantastic New Year!

notes.title: Sanya's first devlog! devlog#01
notes.content:
[h1]Hallo there! Feeling SANYAstic today?[/h1]

We're thrilled to announce that after relocating to Germany earlier this year, we're back in full swing with game development. We're steadily approaching the Features Complete stage, which is a major milestone for us. It's amazing to receive messages from fans who have been following our game for a long time, eagerly waiting for its release. We share your enthusiasm, but developing a game with a small team and limited funds can be quite challenging. Thank you for supporting us all these years. We appreciate it!

Today we want to update you on what we're currently working on, the game's progress, and what still needs to be done.

[h1]But First things first: Woof-woof!![/h1]

Now that we have you and your trusted pal’s attention... We're putting in a lot of effort to transform the dog into more than just a companion — we want it to become your ultimate best friend! In our game, players will have the ability to give commands, praise, and take care of their furry companion. To make things even more enjoyable, we've introduced a special "dog mode" that makes interacting with your pup easier and more intuitive than ever before. You can now ask your dog to fetch, give a paw, or simply call them whenever you please.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824541/fefee992030cbdd813a54287fb0d2a880596b912.png[/img]

However, we're faced with the challenge of incorporating this into the point-and-click genre, which has its fair share of limitations. For instance, when the dog moves in a 3D space while the player remains in a 2D environment, it causes some glitches in the game. But worry not. We're working hard to find a solution!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824541/b4e762023aadca022292c2ed27b5324cb7164647.png[/img]

We are also super pumped to share that we're still hard at work on the script! The main storyline is already done, but we're still polishing up some additional quests, characters, and activities. For instance, you can already encounter this young boy-seller. His father is involved in some risky business, which adds an interesting and different dynamic to the game. Also, Sanya might find himself caught up in some less-than-pleasant adult conflicts. How? You'll have to play the game to find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824541/b4d351a3c7bee4bf171558019c3a879e8f2ad375.png[/img]

But that's not all! We've also made improvements to the existing content. For instance, we've added a mini-game where you have to write the dog's name on a name tag. We have added texture to the brushes and included cute details (oops, one of the markers doesn't write! Did you ever try wetting such a marker with saliva when you were a child?). These small but significant details collectively contribute to the game's overall impression. We would love for the attention to detail to be felt. Would you like to see a comparison of this mini-game, how it was before and how it looks now?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824541/d5a2895ebacbf6d774e67923367b88b48e0e7fd4.png[/img]

Behind the name helpnode is a small team, so the development takes quite a lot of time. But we are very grateful for your support and attention to the game.

In the meantime, we would really appreciate a thumbs up and comment on how our updates sound. Every like is a nod for us to continue updating you like this!

Cheers!
